notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (content automation for product teams). Ran Hosted API trial; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and residency. Interested in Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic forecast after Hosted trial.

POC highlights and customer quotes:
- 'Hosted response quality is fine; main ask is predictable latency for scheduled marketing bursts.' — VP Eng
- Trial telemetry: baseline daytime traffic ~12 QPS, sustained spikes up to 75 QPS during scheduled campaign windows (approx 10-15 mins), typical concurrency measured at ~40-50 during spikes. Overnight baseline QPS 2-3.

Token mix observed during trial:
- 70% short prompts (user messages + context) ~40-150 tokens each
- 20% medium-context templates + product doc snippets ~300-800 tokens
- 10% long-context summarization jobs extracted from product docs ~1500-3000 tokens
- Measured average tokens per request (trial): ~420 tokens (weighted) -> average tokens/sec during peak bursts ~31.5k tokens/sec at 75 QPS.

Customer requirements (explicit):
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for short prompts, < 1.2s for medium, asynchronous OK for long jobs
- Concurrency target: support 120 concurrent active sessions (planning headroom 2.5x measured peak for safety)
- Data controls: VPC/SAML/KMS and audit logs required, 13-month retention for logs per legal
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, interested in unit economics tradeoffs (quantization + batching recommendations)

Preliminary Dedicated sizing notes (internal):
- Using trial metrics -> target sustained throughput for initial Dedicated baseline: 60 QPS with headroom for 120 QPS bursts and 2x token-rate headroom.
- Token-rate sizing: plan for sustained 25k tokens/sec baseline, peaks up to 40k tokens/sec for 15 min windows.
- Rough capacity estimate: 3-5 x high-memory GPU instances depending on model family and quantization (customer prefers a Llama-variant / open checkpoint). If using aggressive 8-bit quant + batching, lower bound 3 GPUs; conservative (fp16) 5 GPUs.
- Autoscaling policy suggestion: maintain 60 QPS steady, scale +2 GPUs at 50% CPU/GPU utilization or when predicted burst scheduled (customer triggers campaigns).

Pricing & procurement:
- Customer asked for 12-, 6-, and 3-month pricing buckets. Wants comparison Hosted run-rate vs Dedicated commit for 12-month.
- Requested TCO spreadsheet (done) + per-route token breakdown for forecast model (in drive).

Open items / blockers:
- Confirm model family and quantization support (SE to run microbenchmarks w/ customer samples).
- Clarify KMS HSM requirements and timeline for integration with private key store.
- Internal finance needs ARR band justification and runway details for commit.
